excluded_tools.aws___get_presigned_url: Issues pre-signed Amazon S3 URLs for upload and download. A pre-signed upload URL is a write capability, so it is outside this read-only boundary.

notes: These are the AWS MCP Server's own tool names. The server already namespaces its tools with aws___, so the names here keep that prefix.

AgentCore prefixes every action with the gateway target's name, so with the target named aws the gateway actions are aws___aws___<tool>. The doubled prefix is expected and is what the policy engine reports; recording these names without the server's own prefix is what previously produced unrecognized-action failures.
Read-only is enforced by IAM on the gateway role, not by the tool set: aws___run_script inherits the role's permissions and cannot exceed them.
aws___run_script is the AWS API execution tool in the current server tool list; there is no separate call_aws tool.
The Cedar policies in aws-mcp-boundary.tf are generated from this manifest, so adding a tool here also requires a matching policy decision.
